messages:
olivia: quick design review — iterating on the API credentials flows (create / rotate / revoke). sharing a prototype link: https://redwood.internal/proto/keys-v3 :eyes: olivia: main goals: make revoke safer, clarify scopes, improve empty-state discoverability, and fix a11y focus order in modal -> want quick sign-off on copy + interactions today. raj: thanks — high level ok. two product constraints: 1) revoke should be irreversible after 30s (undo toast only), 2) rotation must preserve references (we reassign the id). caroline: uploaded a quick image of the new modal in thread (see link). propose these copy options: - revoke primary: "Revoke key" (destructive) - confirm dialog: "Are you sure? This key will stop working immediately." - undo toast: "Key revoked — Undo" matt: UI nit: the current confirm modal traps focus but the keyboard order is wrong — we need: heading -> body -> cancel -> confirm (confirm last). also add aria-describedby to body. kevin: a11y: confirm dialog needs role=dialog, aria-modal=true, focus set to first focusable element, and the destructive button should have aria-label that includes key name. example: ```html ``` and make the undo toast aria-live=polite. design-bot: Accessibility scan: flagged low-contrast on disabled hint text in empty state. Recommend increase to AA. caroline: for empty state copy options: 1) "Create an API key to start calling the Redwood API. Keep keys secret." 2) friendlier: "No keys yet — create one to start building with the API." Which do we want in the console vs docs? raj: console should be concise. go with #2 in the UI, #1 in docs and onboarding emails. olivia: on permission scoping: current proposal supports scoped keys (read-only, embeddings-only, admin). question: do we show scopes inline on the list or in a flyout? caroline: inline chips make the list noisy at small widths. propose collapsed scope pill on list + hover/focus reveals full scope list. accessible pattern: the pill is a button with aria-expanded. matt: implementation concern: hover-only is bad for keyboard. make it a disclosure button. CSS will handle small screens to open a stacked panel. kevin: ensure pill has text alternative like: ```html
  • embeddings
  • generations
``` This keeps it operable and announced. olivia: revoke flow edge-case: if a key is used in active requests, we should show a warning that existing in-flight requests might fail. do we need an explicit block? raj: yes display a subtle warning in confirm: "Active sessions may fail. Rotate if you want a seamless swap." include link to rotation docs. caroline: copy tweak for rotate modal: - header: "Rotate key" - body: "Rotation will create a new secret and keep the same key id. Update any configs that reference the secret." - CTA primary: "Rotate and get new secret" (opens a one-time secret reveal) matt: on the one-time reveal: we must render the secret in a masked field with a copy button. clicking copy should trigger a transient tooltip ("Copied!") and an analytics event. kevin: ensure the masked input has aria-describedby pointing to a hint: "This secret will be shown once." and that voiceover doesn't read masked content. olivia: decision votes: copy for empty state = #2, revoke confirm copy as above, rotation copy as above, scope pill = disclosure button. any objections? raj: +1 caroline: +1 (will update Figma) matt: +1 (will file PR for focus order and tooltip) kevin: +1 (will add to a11y checklist) olivia: great — action items: - caroline: update Figma + provide final copy snippets (owner) - matt: implement focus order + scope disclosure + undo toast (owner) - kevin: run a11y smoke tests + send checklist (owner) - raj: update docs for rotation + revoke tradeoffs (owner) olivia: timeline: aim to ship to staging by EOD Friday. ping here if blocked. :rocket: matt: quick follow up — should undo window be 30s or 60s? 30s is product ask but 60s better for humans. leaning 30s to match audit logs retention. raj: lean 30s for now, we can iterate. olivia: noted. logged action: "set undo window = 30s". caroline: pushing updated screens in 30m. design-bot: Reminder: open issue about color contrast filed -> #5432. olivia: thanks everyone!
